title: Super Supportive · Episode 27 · 你在笑我吗
description: A midnight tour, a tuna peace offering, and a laugh Alden has never heard. Oil painting × storybook × Mexican relief printmaking.

sceneActivities.activity: Walk, clean windows, share snacks, open tuna, react to cat scratch
sceneActivities.purpose: Physical actions bring companionship into view and overturn Alden’s expectations.
sceneActivities.rendering: 24 sequential oil-painted comic panels; no video.

planning.storytellingVoice: Warm, self-questioning adolescent: source-grounded misplaced confidence in Victor becomes rueful humor and relief.
planning.desire: Spend a companionable night with Gorgon and make peace with Victor.
planning.obstacle: Gorgon’s confinement and Victor’s anger after the carrier.
planning.earlyCare: Alden notices why Gorgon takes care with the windows and brings good tuna for Victor.
planning.payoff: Gorgon laughs openly for the first time Alden has seen; Alden hears amusement in his own hurt protest.
planning.continuingQuestion: What happens when Alden goes to tend his bleeding hand?
planning.direction: Hold the window realization quietly. Stage sudden cat action clearly and briefly; then linger on Gorgon laughing and Alden’s relieved response without advancing automatically.

artDirection.repeatPolicy: Excluded feltboard; downweighted recent media, treatments and influences. Older panel styles unrecorded; opening styles used.
artDirection.texture: Impasto oil on canvas with bold carved relief-print contours and graphic hatch marks; clear figurative storybook staging
artDirection.identity: Alden: brown tousled hair, charcoal hoodie and gray shirt; Gorgon: gray alien, four nasal slits, black eyes, swept head spikes, golden bindings; Victor: scarred orange tomcat

continuation.end: Alden and Gorgon tour and clean the consulate. Alden realizes the windows are as close as Gorgon can get to outside. Back in the lobby, Victor accepts Gorgon but attacks Alden’s right hand despite a tuna peace offering. Gorgon laughs openly; Alden feels relief and amusement through the pain. He announces he will wash his bleeding hand. No blood offer or eye contact yet.
continuation.nextStart: He cupped his other hand beneath the bitten one
continuation.note: Alden pauses before washing, proposes blood, struggles to interpret Gorgon’s silence, and approaches to offer his hand. End at their first direct eye contact, before its profound effect.
